style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#F9FAFB;strokeColor=#6B7280;spacing=8;rounded=1;arcSize=3;" value="<b>Bands (proposals; RAI approves them)</b><br>failure_rate = failed_count / request_count. Green: under 0.01. Amber: 0.01 to 0.05. Red: 0.05 or more. Not measured when request_count is 0 (no_requests).<br>volume_change = request_count / median of the last 5 runs. Green: 0.7 to 1.3. Amber: 0.4 to 0.7, or 1.3 to 2.0. Red: under 0.4, or over 2.0. Not measured with fewer than 5 earlier runs (no_baseline).<br>turnaround_s = completed_at − submitted_at. Green: the limit of the use case or less. Amber: 2 × the limit or less. Red: more than 2 × the limit. Not measured without submitted_at or without a limit in the registry (not_reported).<br>The record metrics are Unknown with records_not_approved in October and are not in the roll-up. The delivery lane is graded separately (state diagram use-case-delivery)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1150" x="40" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Bands (proposals; RAI approves them)
failure_rate = failed_count / request_count. Green: under 0.01. Amber: 0.01 to 0.05. Red: 0.05 or more. Not measured when request_count is 0 (no_requests).
volume_change = request_count / median of the last 5 runs. Green: 0.7 to 1.3. Amber: 0.4 to 0.7, or 1.3 to 2.0. Red: under 0.4, or over 2.0. Not measured with fewer than 5 earlier runs (no_baseline).
turnaround_s = completed_at − submitted_at. Green: the limit of the use case or less. Amber: 2 × the limit or less. Red: more than 2 × the limit. Not measured without submitted_at or without a limit in the registry (not_reported).
The record metrics are Unknown with records_not_approved in October and are not in the roll-up. The delivery lane is graded separately (state diagram use-case-delivery).
